title: [ingest] linkcheck_allowed_redirects default is a sentinel class, not None or {}
summary: `linkcheck_allowed_redirects` is registered with `_SENTINEL_LAR` (a dedicated sentinel class) as its default, not an empty dict or `None`. The `compile_linkcheck_allowed_redirects` hook checks `is _SENTINEL_LAR` to detect the unset state. Code that checks `if not config.linkcheck_allowed_redirects` will incorrectly treat the sentinel as falsy and skip initialization.
